items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Oh yeah, Lawrence was a good little trumpet player. Very strong. ... Lawrence way younger than me.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Lawrence was a good little trumpet player. Very strong. Very strong. He was strong. Lawrence was a good little trumpet player. Where he live now, you know? Lawrence live on somewhere around Diabody Street. He was supposed to get married, I believe. If he got married, he lived in the project now, in Rocheblade. You can find it right there, Rocheblade in Orleans. Yeah. Between Orleans and St. Peter. Oh. And that was automatic that woman used to live with a long time ago.
One time George Lewis told me that Lawrence Toka, hip hop, one time played something like Buddy Petit.
